notes: בֹּגְדִים is realized twice — as the English subject *the treacherous* and as the possessive *their own* recasting its genitive relation — and both belong to its one discontinuous unit under rule 25. The competing reading marks *the treacherous* `added` under rule 17, but that ruling governs an English noun answering to no morpheme at all, and here a written nominal answers to it.
This differs from a bare supplied possessive: the possessor role *their* expresses is the very genitive relation the construct chain הַוַּת בֹּגְדִים writes, which is rule 29's possessive recasting.
